'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Calvin Kurten DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Calvin Kurten]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal?]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
